text:
Alice N.: @Linda (Vendor) quick heads-up: our scanner flagged a publicly readable object in your S3 bucket that contains a config with what looks like an AWS role ARN and two short-lived creds. Can you confirm?
Ben C.: tagging sec-ops. do we have the blob? can you paste the object key (no creds in channel)
Alice N.: Object key: vendor-configs/prod/orchard-service.json
Alice N.: here's a redacted snippet (saved to private incident doc):
```json
{
  "kms_key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "service_account": "svc-orchard-prod",
  "access_key_id": "AKIA...REDACTED"
}
```
Cassie (Sec Ops): devsec-bot alerted earlier at 1830201100 with severity HIGH. adding incident channel.
devsec-bot: [ALERT] external-s3-exposure detected: public-read object vendor-configs/prod/orchard-service.json. uid=ext-s3-9876 link=https://internal/alerts/ext-s3-9876
Maya (Eng): do we know whether those creds were used against our APIs? I can grep logs if someone gives me the access key id (redacted) or the ARN.
Alice N.: Linda said they rotated creds ~90m ago but we need a definitive rotation timestamp and KMS key rotation status. Linda?
Linda (Vendor): Confirmed rotating now. We disabled public read and rotated the IAM keys. KMS key is customer-managed; policy might allow our service account. We'll share a signed statement and rotation timestamps within 1h. Apologies — misconfigured CI deploy step.
Cassie (Sec Ops): Action items: 1) Vendor provide rotation timestamps + object access logs 2) Vendor confirm KMS key policy hasn't granted cross-account decrypt to our account 3) We run quick blast to find any use of the rotated keys in our logs 4) Rotate any internal tokens that might have referenced the vendor role
Ben C.: I'm running a query across api_gateway logs for any requests authenticated with that principal/role-arn. ETA 20m.
Maya (Eng): also scanning cloudtrail for AssumeRole/Decrypt calls with that KMS key arn. will post matches.
Evan (Legal): if the vendor had plaintext creds in a public object, we need to evaluate disclosure obligations. Linda, include the geographic regions of affected customers and whether any customer data was accessed. Notify me as soon as you have rotation proof.
Cassie (Sec Ops): containment checklist (doing in parallel):
- Revoke any referenced IAM role ARNs in our org allowlists (Ben)
- Add temporary deny policy for that KMS key cross-account decrypt until vendor provides proof (Ops)
- Snapshot S3 access logs and object versions (Alice)
- Generate list of internal services that called vendor endpoints in the last 7d (Maya)
Ben C.: revoked role from allowlist and flagged for fallback routing. pushed policy change at 1830201305.
Alice N.: snapshot created and uploaded to internal vault -> link: https://internal/vault/incident/1830201122 (access limited).
Maya (Eng): cloudtrail search found 3 Decrypt events with that KMS key arn between 1830200500-1830200900 from an IP range mapped to vendor infra. attaching hashed request ids to incident doc.
Cassie (Sec Ops): that suggests exfil may have occurred before rotation window. escalate to full incident. Evan, please advise on notification cadence.
Evan (Legal): Stand up a brief for leadership. Hold external notification until we have vendor attestations and we can confirm impact scope. If customer data touched, we'll follow breach notification timelines per region.
Linda (Vendor): We're preparing: rotation proof, S3 access logs (who accessed object), CI pipeline change that caused publish, and a remediation plan (IAM least-privilege + automated bucket policy checks). Will post within 45m.
Cassie (Sec Ops): Post-incident asks for vendor: 1) root cause timeline 2) full access log export (S3 + CloudTrail) 3) signed key rotation proof 4) updated KMS key policy + rotation schedule 5) evidence of pipeline change review 6) SOC2/ISO contacts.
Ben C.: Also recommend they publish future KMS keys as alias-only and rotate monthly, plus MFA enforced on console.
Alice N.: quick technical note for infra: confirm whether we ever stored vendor creds in our secret stores (vault, ssm). I'm running a search across vault paths referencing svc-orchard-prod.
Maya (Eng): found two repo commits referencing svc-orchard-prod in terraform state from 30d ago. both were marked redacted in git history, but I'll rotate any generated outputs.
Cassie (Sec Ops): timeline update: 1830201400 vendor confirms rotation started; 1830201500 vendor disabled public read; 1830201520 we added temporary KMS deny policy; 1830201600 we escalated to incident with legal.
devsec-bot: [ACTION LOG] 1830201520 policy-change: temporary-kms-deny applied by Ben C. ticket=INC-2431
Evan (Legal): keep a tight chain of custody on all logs. don't share raw logs externally without NDA addendum.
Linda (Vendor): uploading artifacts to a secure shared bucket now (signed link will be sent to Evan + Cassie).
Cassie (Sec Ops): next steps for us: finish log correlation, confirm customer impact (if any), prepare internal incident brief for leadership, and draft a customer-safe comms template if required. Reassigning follow-ups in incident tracker.
Alice N.: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread when vendor artifacts are validated. :thumbsup:
Ben C.: I'll post any API matches.
Maya (Eng): continuing scans, will report findings.
Evan (Legal): standing by for vendor attestations before external notices.
devsec-bot: [RESCORE] severity -> CRITICAL (confirmed cross-account decrypt events).
Cassie (Sec Ops): marking incident as active. creating postmortem once root cause confirmed.
